backend/main.mo: Main backend canister defining authorization mixins, admin password handling, user profiles, parent‑child links, schedules, content filters, activity/location logs, audit logs, and related state types.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing background location, PWA, and transparency‑copy updates with associated files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of numerous frontend files including components, hooks, and pages.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base/theme variables defining color tokens for light and dark modes and global element styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the app root, manifest, icons, metadata, and main script.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, display mode, colors, and categories.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handling caching, fetch fallback, and background/periodic sync for queued location updates.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling authentication, role routing, theming, i18n, and conditional rendering of dashboards and modals.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccountsTa: Displays a list of user accounts with role labels and buttons to enable or disable accounts, including a dialog to enter a disable reason.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPassw: Provides forms to verify or change the admin password, handling validation and error states.
frontend/src/components/admin/Aggregated: Shows aggregated system metrics in card form, including user counts and pairings.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertsPan: Shows a child's daily activity status versus their time limit and allows requesting more time when over limit.
Displays a parent's view of a child's daily usage relative to their time limit with status alerts.
frontend/src/components/audit/AuditLogTa: Fetches and displays sorted audit log entries with action labels, executor info, and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Handles Internet Identity login/logout with status feedback and admin gate clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Provides a modal form for new users to enter their name and select a parent or child role, then saves the profile.
frontend/src/components/child/ActivityHi: Fetches and displays a child’s submitted activities in a sortable table with optional transparency labeling.
frontend/src/components/child/ChildCheck: Allows children to submit activities and locations, manage consent, and toggle live location sharing with capability checks.
frontend/src/components/child/ConsentNot: Shows a consent notice with icon and text for activity, location, or pairing actions.
frontend/src/components/child/LocationHi: Fetches and displays a table of a child’s location history with coordinates and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/filters/ContentF: Lets parents configure content filter categories and manage allowlist and blocklist entries for a child.
Shows a read‑only view of a child's content filter policy with category, allowlist, and blocklist details.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSel: Provides a dropdown for switching the app’s language between English and Portuguese.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Renders the app footer with copyright, transparency policy link, and a Caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Renders the app header with user info, theme toggle, language selector, login, and transparency button.
frontend/src/components/parent/ActivityV: Shows a notice about voluntary data and displays a child's activity history list.
frontend/src/components/parent/ChildSumm: Displays a child's summary card with recent activity, check-in time, and shared location count.
frontend/src/components/parent/LocationV: Shows live or historical location data for a child, including last update status and warnings.
frontend/src/components/parent/PairingSe: Generates and copies a mock pairing code with warnings and helper text.
frontend/src/components/schedule/Schedul: Provides a UI to edit a child's schedule, daily limits, and allowed time windows.
Displays a child's configured schedule and time windows in read-only form.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGate.ts: Tracks whether an admin gate has been passed using session storage.
frontend/src/hooks/useI18n.ts: Exposes translation context through a simple hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, handling login, stored identity restoration, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveLocationSharin: Implements periodic geolocation capture, submission, error handling, and queued retries with background sync support.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor calls with React Query hooks for profiles, roles, relationships, activities, and locations, including mutations with toast notifications.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: Defines an i18n provider with language persistence, translation lookup, and a context hook.
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Exports locale types, translation maps, and supported languages.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/en.ts: Contains English translation strings for UI text and labels.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/pt-BR.ts: Contains Brazilian Portuguese translation strings for UI text and labels.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind layers and defines light/dark theme CSS variables including navy color tokens and global base styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard showing aggregated metrics, user accounts, and parent-child link data in tabbed views.
frontend/src/pages/child/ChildHome.tsx: Child dashboard showing profile info, alerts, and tabs for check-in, history, schedule, filters, and alerts.
frontend/src/pages/parent/ParentDashboar: Parent dashboard listing children and providing tabbed tools for activity, location, schedule, filters, alerts, and audit logs.
Displays a modal card with multiple policy sections using i18n text and scrollable content.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Handles service worker registration and provides helpers for background and periodic sync requests.
frontend/src/utils/liveLocationCapabilit: Detects geolocation and background capability support and returns a user-facing capability message.
frontend/src/utils/locationUpdateQueue.t: Implements a localStorage-backed queue for location updates with retry handling and size limits.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities to read URL parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and remove them from hashes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Describes project state, features, and requirements for background live location sharing support.
